name: methyltransferase 14, N6-adenosine-methyltransferase non-catalytic subunit

function.text: METTL14 is the approved symbol for methyltransferase 14, N6-adenosine-methyltransferase non-catalytic subunit. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in mRNA binding; mRNA m(6)A methyltransferase activity; DNA damage response.

function.text: METTL14 encodes methyltransferase 14, N6-adenosine-methyltransferase non-catalytic subunit. Based in part on similarity, the METTL3-METTL14 heterodimer forms a N6-methyltransferase complex that methylates adenosine residues at the N(6) position of some mRNAs and regulates the circadian clock, differentiation of embryonic stem cells and cortical neurogenesis. M6A regulates spermatogonial differentiation and meiosis and is essential for male fertility and spermatogenesis. M6A also regulates cortical neurogenesis: m6A methylation of transcripts related to transcription factors, neural stem cells, the cell cycle and neuronal differentiation during brain development promotes their destabilization and decay, promoting differentiation of radial glial cells.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving METTL14 have been reported in endometrial carcinoma, nasopharyngeal carcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
